title: Easy Crisp Vietnamese Pork Bun Thit Nuong
description: A lazy Sunday Vietnamese dish featuring fatty and crisp pork, brown rice, and fresh herbs, this recipe is perfect for a relaxing weekend meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and black pepper.
Add the pork shoulder to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the pork with vegetable oil and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the pickled carrots by slicing them thinly and soaking them in rice vinegar.
After the pork has cooked for 20 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until crispy.
Slice the pork into thin strips and serve with brown rice, pickled carrots, and cilantro.
Garnish with additional cilantro and serve immediately.
